craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vidhi unit 52. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Mental this but others, Padmā and the rest eight mudrikās; in Mātṛ-vyūha-kula they would be of her and attendants.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mānasīyamitastvanyāḥ padmādyā aṣṭa mudrikāḥ mātṛvyūhakule tāḥ syurasyāstu parivāragāḥ
